# HaiEduTech

> AI-powered personalized learning platform by Mr. Hai Nguyen — IELTS, TOEIC, HSK Chinese, Finnish YKI, Vietnamese, Python programming, and global study abroad guidance.

HaiEduTech combines 15+ years of language teaching with data engineering and AI to deliver adaptive lessons, smart grading, speaking coaches, and personalized roadmaps. Built and maintained by Hai Nguyen (Founder & Lead Educator).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of all programs and AI learning tools.
- [About](/about): Founder story, qualifications, and methodology.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach Mr. Hai for tutoring or collaboration.
